type.description: The type id of the response

kind.description: The kind of participant, service, agent or extra

subject.description: The clock subject of an extra participant

reference.description: True for the service, whose host's clock every offset is measured against

shared_clock.description: True for a participant that reads the service host's clock, reported with a zero offset without a probe

offset.description: The participant's clock less the service host's in nanoseconds, positive when it is ahead

round_trip.description: The probe's time in flight in nanoseconds

bound.description: Half the round trip in nanoseconds, the true offset lies within it of offset

error.description: Why an extra participant could not be measured, offset, round_trip and bound are zero when set

participants.description: Each participant's clock, the service first, then the agents, then the extra subjects
